work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult LVIII grants the violet collar, cassock and sash to the Civitavecchia cathedral canons; LF10255 → LF10264 across own provenance LF10258 and page-70 running title LF10261; complete 11 September 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF10194–10194; the source closing at LF10279–10282 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima prima ‘ septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno uinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
